rules.title: BOM component compliance is missing or failing
rules.description: Checks populated BOM components for RoHS/REACH compliance metadata. Runs only when explicitly enabled.
rules.rationale: Non-compliant or undocumented parts create regulatory and shipment risk for the assembled product.

rules.title: BOM DNP state differs from PCB population state
rules.description: Compares BOM do-not-populate flags with PCB footprint population attributes.
rules.rationale: A BOM and PCB population mismatch can fabricate or assemble the wrong variant.

rules.title: BOM part is marked EOL
rules.description: Checks lifecycle-style BOM fields for end-of-life and not-recommended markers.
rules.rationale: End-of-life components create sourcing and redesign risk before fabrication.

rules.title: BOM footprint differs from PCB footprint
rules.description: Compares normalized BOM footprint values with PCB footprint assignments.
rules.rationale: Footprint mismatches can make sourced parts incompatible with the fabricated board.

rules.title: BOM component identity conflict
rules.description: Detects components whose identity fields (MPN, manufacturer) differ between BOM and schematic sources, or appear multiple times within the same BOM with conflicting values.
rules.rationale: Conflicting component identities produce ambiguous sourcing decisions and unreliable release diffs. A stable, consistent identity ensures every tool in the release pipeline references the same part.

rules.title: BOM component lifecycle status is risky
rules.description: Checks BOM lifecycle fields and local lifecycle data for risky component states.
rules.rationale: Lifecycle risk should be visible before teams commit to parts and fab outputs.

rules.title: BOM row is missing manufacturer part number
rules.description: Checks populated BOM and schematic rows for missing manufacturer part numbers.
rules.rationale: Assembly sourcing needs stable part numbers to avoid ambiguous substitutions.

rules.title: BOM component has elevated supply-chain risk
rules.description: Scores each populated BOM row on missing MPN, missing manufacturer, no suppliers, and single-source-without-alternates signals. Emits a finding per at-risk component so release readiness reflects aggregate BOM supply-chain quality.
rules.rationale: Individual per-row rules catch specific issues, but a scoring approach lets teams set a single policy gate that blocks production releases when the overall BOM quality falls below an acceptable threshold.

rules.title: BOM part has a single supplier
rules.description: Checks supplier metadata for BOM rows that only list one source.
rules.rationale: Single-source parts increase procurement risk when a supplier changes availability.

rules.title: BOM component lifecycle status is unknown
rules.description: Flags components that have no lifecycle data from any source (BOM field, lifecycle database, or supplier plugin). Unknown lifecycle status is not silently treated as safe — the absence of data is itself a supply-chain signal.
rules.rationale: Teams often assume a missing lifecycle field means the part is active. Surfacing unknown status makes the gap explicit so reviewers can decide whether to accept the risk.

rules.title: Variant BOM contains a DNP override component
rules.description: Checks KiCad variant DNP overrides against each variant-specific BOM.
rules.rationale: Variant BOM drift can populate components that a selected hardware variant excludes.

rules.title: PCB outline is not closed
rules.description: Checks that the PCB Edge.Cuts outline is present and closes into a board boundary.
rules.rationale: Fabricators need a closed outline to route the intended physical board shape.

rules.title: PCB copper coverage is below the configured balance threshold
rules.description: Checks filled copper coverage on PCB layers against the configured minimum.
rules.rationale: Low copper coverage can flag process and board-quality risks before release.

rules.title: Duplicate reference designators
rules.description: Flags board footprints that share a reference designator.
rules.rationale: Duplicate reference designators make BOM, placement, and assembly mapping ambiguous.

rules.title: KiCad DRC findings
rules.description: Runs KiCad PCB design-rule checks and normalizes their diagnostics into findings.
rules.rationale: KiCad DRC findings expose layout violations that should be reviewed before fabrication.

rules.title: KiCad ERC findings
rules.description: Runs KiCad schematic electrical-rule checks and normalizes their diagnostics into findings.
rules.rationale: ERC diagnostics catch schematic connectivity and electrical intent problems early.

rules.title: Arduino firmware pin contract does not match hardware pinmap
rules.description: Checks an Arduino/C `#define` firmware pin header against the BoardReadyOps pinmap.
rules.rationale: Firmware pin macros that drift from the hardware pinmap can ship boards whose code drives the wrong net or component pin.

rules.title: ESP-IDF firmware pin contract does not match hardware pinmap
rules.description: Checks an ESP-IDF firmware pin contract YAML against the BoardReadyOps pinmap.
rules.rationale: Firmware pin assignments that drift from the hardware pinmap can ship boards whose code drives the wrong net or component pin.

rules.title: PlatformIO firmware pin contract does not match hardware pinmap
rules.description: Checks a PlatformIO-style firmware pin contract against the BoardReadyOps pinmap.
rules.rationale: Firmware pin assignments that drift from the hardware pinmap can ship boards whose code drives the wrong net or component pin.

rules.title: STM32CubeMX pin assignment does not match hardware pinmap
rules.description: Parses a STM32CubeMX `.ioc` project file and checks GPIO labels against the BoardReadyOps pinmap.
rules.rationale: STM32CubeMX GPIO labels that drift from the hardware pinmap can ship boards whose code drives the wrong net or component pin.

rules.title: Zephyr firmware pin contract does not match hardware pinmap
rules.description: Checks a Zephyr firmware pin contract YAML against the BoardReadyOps pinmap.
rules.rationale: Firmware pin assignments that drift from the hardware pinmap can ship boards whose code drives the wrong net or component pin.

rules.title: Bottom-side assembly components
rules.description: Reports assembly components placed on the bottom copper layer.
rules.rationale: Bottom-side placement adds a second assembly pass and stencil; flag it when single-side assembly is expected.

rules.title: IC or connector may lack a clear pin-1 marker
rules.description: Checks that ICs and polarised connectors use recognized library footprints that include standard pin-1 markers.
rules.rationale: Without a clear pin-1 marker, components can be placed 180° rotated, causing immediate board failure and difficult rework.

rules.title: Polarized component may lack a clear polarity marking
rules.description: Checks that polarized components (diodes, LEDs, electrolytic capacitors) use recognized library footprints that include standard polarity markings.
rules.rationale: Missing or ambiguous polarity marks cause assembly errors and can permanently damage polarized components on the first power-on.

rules.title: Dense SMD board: verify silkscreen does not overlap pads
rules.description: Flags boards with a high density of SMD components as a reminder to verify that silkscreen markings do not overlap solder pads.
rules.rationale: Silkscreen ink on solder pads can cause poor solder joints and tombstoning. Dense SMD layouts are particularly at risk. KiCad DRC includes a silkscreen clearance check that should be enabled for production boards.

rules.title: Drill file does not cover PCB drill sizes
rules.description: Compares PCB drill sizes with generated Excellon drill outputs.
rules.rationale: Missing drill coverage can make a fabrication package incomplete or incorrect.

rules.title: Fabrication notes are missing
rules.description: Checks known project paths for fabrication notes that travel with board outputs.
rules.rationale: Fabrication notes preserve process assumptions that output files alone do not encode.

rules.title: Assembly fiducials are missing
rules.description: Checks configured assembly jobs for a minimum number of fiducial footprints.
rules.rationale: Fiducials help assembly equipment align the board reliably before pick-and-place.

rules.title: Enabled KiCad jobset output is missing
rules.description: Checks enabled KiCad jobset entries for their expected output files.
rules.rationale: Jobset definitions are only useful when the released outputs they promise exist.

rules.title: PCB stackup layer count does not match expected copper layers
rules.description: Compares the parsed PCB stackup layer count with configured expectations.
rules.rationale: Stackup mismatches change fabrication cost and electrical assumptions.

rules.title: Required manufacturing outputs are missing or stale
rules.description: Checks required fabrication outputs and whether they are fresh relative to PCB sources.
rules.rationale: A release without current manufacturing outputs is not ready to send to a fab.

rules.title: Release package is incomplete
rules.description: Validates that the release package includes all required manufacturing output categories. Base categories (gerbers, drill, BOM, CPL) are required for every release. Production categories (fab notes, assembly notes, board PDF) are required when releaseMode is production.
rules.rationale: An incomplete manufacturing package prevents hand-off to fabrication or assembly suppliers. Structured completeness checks enable downstream tools and dashboards to track release readiness.

rules.title: Panelization output is missing
rules.description: Checks panelized manufacturing configurations for panel output files.
rules.rationale: Panelized jobs need the panel artifacts the assembler and fabricator expect.

rules.title: Position output does not cover populated assembly references
rules.description: Checks configured assembly jobs for position/CPL output coverage of populated PCB references.
rules.rationale: Pick-and-place data must cover populated components so assembly review does not miss placements.

rules.title: Test points are missing
rules.description: Checks for a configured minimum number of test point footprints for in-circuit or functional test.
rules.rationale: Accessible test points let assembly and QA validate power and key nets without reworking the board.

rules.title: Tooling holes are missing
rules.description: Checks configured fabrication/assembly jobs for a minimum number of tooling or mounting holes.
rules.rationale: Tooling holes help fixture, panel, and assembly workflows locate the board mechanically.

rules.title: Pinmap contains duplicate pin or net entries
rules.description: Checks pinmap files for duplicate pin and net assignments.
rules.rationale: Pinmap collisions make hardware-to-firmware mappings ambiguous.

rules.title: Pinmap net is not declared as a schematic net label
rules.description: Checks pinmap net names against schematic labels visible to firmware integration.
rules.rationale: Pinmap entries without matching schematic labels are easy to miswire in firmware.

rules.title: Connected schematic pin is missing from the pinmap
rules.description: Checks connected schematic pins for matching pinmap entries.
rules.rationale: Connected pins omitted from a pinmap leave firmware-facing interfaces undocumented.

rules.title: Pinmap net is not present in schematic
rules.description: Checks configured pinmap nets against parsed schematic net labels.
rules.rationale: A pinmap that references absent nets cannot safely guide firmware integration.

rules.title: Changelog entry is missing
rules.description: Checks CHANGELOG.md for an entry matching the board revision.
rules.rationale: Released hardware needs revision notes that reviewers and manufacturers can trace.

rules.title: PCB revision is missing
rules.description: Checks PCB title-block revisions against the configured release tag pattern.
rules.rationale: Boards without stable revisions are difficult to fabricate, review, and reproduce.

rules.title: Git tag does not match PCB revision
rules.description: Checks tag CI context against the board revision recorded in PCB metadata.
rules.rationale: Release tags should identify the exact board revision being fabricated.

rules.title: Board revision does not match release version format
rules.description: Checks schematic and PCB revisions against the configured release version pattern.
rules.rationale: Consistent version formats keep hardware revisions searchable and automatable.
